remarks: Freshly renovated, fully finished temperature-controlled garage/storage space in a convenient, easy-to-access Greenwich, CT location-ideal for discerning car collectors and anyone needing clean, secure storage.  This bright, crisp space features heat and air conditioning for consistent year-round climate control, high ceilings, and a durable epoxy-coated floor that's built for heavy use while staying showroom-clean. Brand new garage doors provide smooth access, and a security system is already in place for peace of mind.  Perfect for classic, exotic, and luxury vehicle storage, or as dry warehouse storage for inventory, equipment, seasonal items, and valuable personal property. Clean, secure, and ready for immediate use.
